Alexander Graham Bell: Alexander Graham Bell invented the telephone in 1876, and it changed how people communicate with each other.
亚历山大•格雷厄姆•贝尔于1876年发明了电话，它改变了人们相互交流的方式。
put on: He put on a lot of weight after eating fast food almost every day.
在几乎每天吃快餐之后，他的体重增加了很多。
lay out: She laid out the map on the table and showed us the best route.
她把地图摊开摆在桌上，给我们指出了最佳路线。
Chiang Mai: My cousin spent a week in Chiang Mai and fell in love with the quiet temples there.
我表哥在清迈待了一个星期，并爱上了那里安静的寺庙。
Valentine’s Day: He gave his mother a bunch of red flowers on Valentine’s Day this year.
今年情人节那天，他送给妈妈一束红玫瑰。
Charles Dickens: Charles Dickens wrote many famous novels about the lives of poor children in England.
查尔斯•狄更斯写了许多关于英国贫困儿童生活的著名小说。
Jacob Marley: In the story, Jacob Marley appears as a ghost and warns his old friend to change.
在故事中，雅各布•马利化作幽灵出现，警告他的老朋友要改过自新。
from time to time: I still meet my old classmates from time to time, though we now live far apart.
虽然我们现在住得很远，但我仍不时和老同学们见面。
deal with: Learning to deal with stress is an important skill for every student.
学会应对压力是每个学生的一项重要技能。
be proud of: Her parents were proud of her when she won first place in the competition.
当她在比赛中获得第一名时，她的父母为她感到骄傲。
boarding school: His parents sent him to a boarding school when he was ten years old.
他十岁时，父母把他送进了一所寄宿学校。
in person: You can apply for the job online, but you must sign the paper in person.
你可以在网上申请这份工作，但必须亲自签署文件。
take pride in: Good workers take pride in what they do, even in the smallest tasks.
优秀的员工为自己所做的一切感到自豪，哪怕是最琐碎的工作。
no matter: No matter how difficult the exam is, you should stay calm and confident.
无论考试多么难，你都应该保持冷静和自信。
San Francisco: They took a cable car to see the famous bridges of San Francisco last summer.
去年夏天他们乘坐缆车去游览旧金山著名的桥梁。
by accident: I found the old photo by accident while I was cleaning my desk.
我在整理书桌时偶然发现了那张旧照片。
take place: The sports meeting will take place next Friday if the weather is fine.
如果天气好的话，运动会将于下周五举行。
without doubt: This is without doubt the best movie I have seen this year.
毫无疑问，这是我看过的今年最好的电影。
all of a sudden: The sky was clear, but all of a sudden it started to rain heavily.
天空原本晴朗，但突然之间下起了大雨。
by mistake: Someone took my umbrella by mistake because the two umbrellas looked the same.
有人错拿了我的伞，因为这两把伞看起来一模一样。
divide ... into: The teacher divided the class into four small groups for the discussion.
老师把全班分成四个小组进行讨论。
the Olympics: Athletes from all over the world compete in the Olympics every four years.
来自世界各地的运动员每四年参加一次奥林匹克运动会。
look up to: Young players look up to their experienced teammates and learn from them every day.
年轻队员钦佩经验丰富的队友，并每天向他们学习。
Chelsea Lanmon: In the survey, Chelsea Lanmon said the most useful invention was the washing machine.
在调查中，切尔西•兰曼说最有用的发明是洗衣机。
Jayce Coziar: Jayce Coziar believes shoes with special heels would make people walk more comfortably.
杰斯•克里亚认为带特殊鞋跟的鞋子会让人们走路更舒服。
Jamie Ellsworth: Jamie Ellsworth would like to invent a special pen that can write by itself.
杰米•埃尔斯沃恩想发明一种能自动书写的特殊钢笔。
Julie Thompson: Julie Thompson said the car was the most helpful invention in her daily life.
朱莉•汤普森说汽车是她日常生活中最有帮助的发明。
Whitcomb Judson: Whitcomb Judson invented an early kind of zipper for shoes in the 1890s.
19世纪90年代，惠特科姆•贾德森发明了一种早期用于鞋子的拉链。
Thomas Watson: Thomas Watson heard Bell's voice through the first telephone and rushed to answer it.
托马斯•沃森通过第一部电话听到了贝尔的声音，并赶紧过去接听。
George Crum: George Crum invented potato chips when a customer kept complaining about the thick fries.
乔治•克拉姆在一位顾客不断抱怨薯条太厚时发明了薯片。
James Naismith: James Naismith invented basketball so that his students could play indoors in the cold winter.
詹姆斯•奈史密斯发明了篮球，以便他的学生在寒冷的冬天能在室内运动。
talk back: My parents get angry whenever I talk back to them at home.
每当我在家里顶嘴时，父母就会生气。
keep away from: You should keep away from the fire because it is really dangerous.
你应该远离火，因为它真的很危险。
make one’s own decision: Teenagers should be allowed to make their own decisions about their hobbies.
应该允许青少年就自己的爱好做出决定。
get in the way of: Don't let playing computer games get in the way of your studies.
不要让玩电脑游戏妨碍你的学习。
not only … but also: This dictionary is not only useful but also cheap, so many students buy it.
这本词典不但有用而且便宜，所以很多学生都买它。
J. K. Rowling: J. K. Rowling became famous after her story about a young wizard was published.
J. K.罗琳在关于一位年轻巫师的故事出版后变得出名。
Paul Stoker: Paul Stoker would like to invent a robot that can do all the housework.
保罗•斯托克想发明一个能做所有家务的机器人。
in that case: We may be a little late; in that case, please start dinner without us.
我们可能会迟到一会儿；那样的话，请你们先吃饭，不用等我们。
plenty of: Drink plenty of water every day, especially when you do sports.
每天要喝大量的水，尤其是在运动的时候。
